import json
p='template.js'

a=s.index('var NOACG_ANIM = {')+len('var NOACG_ANIM = ')

      ".public-info-tag-%d"%n:{"opacity":[{"time":0.1,"value":0.5},{"time":0.4,"value":1}]}}}
for st in anim['machine']['groups'][0]['states']:
    if st['id'] in ('language-1','language-2'):
        st['timeline']=kf(int(st['id'][-1]))

open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
EOF
